title: Quote: The reason I went back to Apple is that I feel like the worl...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Man in the News: Steve Jobs
content: The reason I went back to Apple is that I feel like the world would be a better place with Apple in it than not. And it's hard to imagine the world without Apple now.
full_transcript: The reason I went back to Apple is that I feel like the world would be a better place with Apple in it than not. And it's hard to imagine the world without Apple now.
